save_net_model: save a PyTorch network state dict to a file in the specified model directory with an optional suffix
load_net_model: load a PyTorch network state dict from a file in the specified model directory with an optional suffix
update_lr_newbob_adam: update the learning rate based on current loss and historic loss values using the NewbobAdam optimizer
compute_mag_spectrogram: compute the magnitude spectrogram from an audio waveform tensor using a configurable Fourier transform
reconstruct_wav_from_magphase: reconstruct a wav signal from magnitude and phase spectrogram tensors using inverse STFT
